evidence: The film thickness was measured by field emission scanning electron microscopy, and the film resistivity was calculated from the sheet resistance measured by the four-point probe method. X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements using Cu K radiation of λ = 1.5405 Å was used to examine the crystal structure of the deposited films. The film composition and density were measured using Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and 2.43 MeV He2+ Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS).
